import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Stress Level'], s=df['Physical Activity Level']*2,
                      alpha=0.7, cmap='RdYlBu_r')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Stress Level\n(size = Physical Activity)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Stress Level')

# Add BMI category labels
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax1.annotate(row['BMI Category'], (row['Sleep Duration'], row['Quality of Sleep']),
                xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=8)

# 2. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Occupation
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
occupations = df['Occupation'].unique()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(occupations)))

for occ, color in zip(occupations, colors):
    subset = df[df['Occupation'] == occ]
    ax2.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Daily Steps'],
                label=occ, color=color, s=100, alpha=0.7)
    # Add heart rate as text
    for _, row in subset.iterrows():
        ax2.annotate(f"HR: {row['Heart Rate']}", 
                    (row['Physical Activity Level'], row['Daily Steps']),
                    xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=8)

ax2.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax2.set_ylabel('Daily Steps')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Occupation')
ax2.legend(title='Occupation')

# 3. Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
bmi_categories = df['BMI Category'].unique()
sleep_data = [df[df['BMI Category'] == cat]['Sleep Duration'] for cat in bmi_categories]

bp = ax3.boxplot(sleep_data, labels=bmi_categories, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], plt.cm.Set2.colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)

ax3.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax3.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax3.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category')

# Add individual points
for i, category in enumerate(bmi_categories):
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == category]
    y = subset['Sleep Duration']
    x = np.random.normal(i + 1, 0.04, size=len(y))
    ax3.scatter(x, y, alpha=0.6, s=50, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)

# 4. Correlation heatmap of numerical variables
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level',
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()

im = ax4.imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(numerical_cols)))
ax4.set_yticks(range(len(numerical_cols)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(numerical_cols, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.set_yticklabels(numerical_cols)

# Add correlation values
for i in range(len(numerical_cols)):
    for j in range(len(numerical_cols)):
        text = ax4.text(j, i, f'{corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                       ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=9)

ax4.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Numerical Variables')
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax4)

# 5. Stress Level by Occupation with Sleep Disorder indication
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
occupation_stress = df.groupby('Occupation')['Stress Level'].mean().sort_values()

bars = ax5.barh(range(len(occupation_stress)), occupation_stress.values, 
                color=plt.cm.Paired(np.linspace(0, 1, len(occupation_stress))))
ax5.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_stress)))
ax5.set_yticklabels(occupation_stress.index)
ax5.set_xlabel('Average Stress Level')
ax5.set_title('Average Stress Level by Occupation')

# Add sleep disorder indication
for i, occ in enumerate(occupation_stress.index):
    has_disorder = any(df[(df['Occupation'] == occ) & (df['Sleep Disorder'] != '')]['Sleep Disorder'])
    if has_disorder:
        bars[i].set_edgecolor('red')
        bars[i].set_linewidth(2)
        ax5.text(occupation_stress.values[i] + 0.1, i, '⚠', 
                va='center', color='red', fontsize=12)

# 6. Blood Pressure analysis
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
# Parse blood pressure values
systolic = []
diastolic = []
for bp in df['Blood Pressure']:
    s, d = map(int, bp.split('/'))
    systolic.append(s)
    diastolic.append(d)

sc = ax6.scatter(systolic, diastolic, c=df['Heart Rate'], 
                s=df['Age']*10, alpha=0.7, cmap='viridis')
ax6.axhline(y=80, color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label='Normal Diastolic')
ax6.axvline(x=120, color='r', linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label='Normal Systolic')
ax6.set_xlabel('Systolic Blood Pressure')
ax6.set_ylabel('Diastolic Blood Pressure')
ax6.set_title('Blood Pressure Analysis\n(size = Age, color = Heart Rate)')
plt.colorbar(sc, ax=ax6, label='Heart Rate')
ax6.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=8)

# Add BMI category labels
for i, (s, d) in enumerate(zip(systolic, diastolic)):
    ax6.annotate(df.iloc[i]['BMI Category'], (s, d),
                xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=8)

plt.suptitle('Health and Sleep Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
